name: @hookswap/trading-api-adapter
description: Trading-API-schema adapter for HookSwap. Speaks the exact Trading API schema the HookSwap interface calls (POST /v1/quote, GET /v1/swappable_tokens, ...) and computes routes via HookSwap's own smart-order-router / routing-api. Lets the interface's TRADING_API_URL_OVERRIDE point here instead of Uniswap's hosted Trading API (which only serves Uniswap chains).
